observations: body L2-L3: «an–Nayrīzī» is divided between the lines with the dash repeated at the head of L3; both parts are letter-spaced.
body L11: a speck stands under the f of «faraǵ»; a curved stroke stands over the n and the o of «anno»; they are not signs.
body L12-L13: a short slanting stroke stands between the lines, under the second t of «obliquitati» and over the t of «potest»; it is not an accent.
body L28: the formula is centred; between «18″.» and «0» the print leaves a space; the minus sign is printed as a long dash and set as a minus sign.
notes_right L7: Ismaël Boulliau's Astronomia philolaica was printed at Paris in 1645; the print reads «1545»; kept as printed.
notes_right L19: «Schiaparelli» is set in small capitals.
